		set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_apportion_winner value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_apportion_active_00_value = 1 aawc_reforging_apportion_remainder_00_value > aawc_reforging_apportion_best_value } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_apportion_best value = aawc_reforging_apportion_remainder_00_value } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_apportion_winner value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { aawc_reforging_apportion_active_01_value = 1 aawc_reforging_apportion_remainder_01_value > aawc_reforging_apportion_best_value } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_apportion_best value = aawc_reforging_apportion_remainder_01_value } set_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_apportion_winner value = 2 } }
